messages.text: In compliance with GDPR regulations, this will permanently delete your entire account and all associated data, including your catalogue, products, and categories. This action cannot be undone!<whisper>I really mean it.</whisper>

Clicking Delete My Account will start the deletion process. We will send a PIN number to your registered phone number to verify that you really want to permanently delete your account.[pause]<whisper>Don't do it!</whisper>
